text: Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. A song. He has set his foundation on the holy mountain;
more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
among those who acknowledge me— Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush— and will say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”
“This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High himself will establish her.”
“This one was born in Zion.” Selah
